tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Fresh new production-quality transparent RGBA illustration: ONE full-body single pose of the exact Setouchi Salamander adopted in image1. Image1 is identity/style/proportion reference only, not an edit target. Highest native resolution available. Preserve precisely its head-to-torso ratio, torso length/thickness, face, eye format, palette, warm brown line character, gentle clean watercolor paper texture, distinctive markings, horns/ears/bill/tail and original limb count. Generous transparent margins around each complete subject. No text, labels, border, grid lines, floor, shadows, background, props, clothing, effects, sparkles or extra animals. Keep the lightly anthropomorphic upright short-legged mascot and original arm-like forelimbs; do not revert to a natural quadruped. All subjects use the SAME head/body size and body reference; only the specified gesture changes. Do not fit or enlarge bent poses. 1 AHA: Gentle happy discovery, alert friendly face and small existing appendage lift, no effect or external object. Species constraints: 自然な四足歩行体へ戻さない。青い斑・背の突起・長い吻・細い尾など個体の採用形を維持し、尾を足や腕へ変えない。 Finish with clear clean face/contours and connected complete appendages, without smudges, patchy pigment blobs, doubled parts, jagged alpha halos or clipping. Open eyes preserve reference design with no new glints. Every single part stays visible within its own transparent area. This replaces only the listed failing pose(s); preserve the reference identity and do not create other states. CRITICAL ANATOMY: The raised forelimb MUST end in a single smoothly rounded mitten animal paw with only the two small curved crease marks adopted in image1. No protruding thumb, human fist, raised index finger or separately articulated fingers.
